title: Tohoku earthquake and tsunami strike Japan
summary: A magnitude 9.0 earthquake off northeastern Japan sent a tsunami that killed about 18,000 people and caused the Fukushima nuclear disaster.
reason: The Pacific Plate slipped violently under Japan along a huge section of fault.
significance: It was Japan's worst disaster since 1945 and turned many countries against nuclear power.
place: Off the Oshika Peninsula, Tohoku, Japan
